items.title: OpenAI unveils its first custom chip, built by Broadcom
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布首款自研芯片，由 Broadcom 打造
items.summary: OpenAI unveiled its first custom chip, built by Broadcom, according to the announcement and coverage linked in the item.

items.title: LastPass notifies users of yet another data breach
items.raw_content: LastPass users are once again being warned about stolen personal data, though this time the breach happened through one of the company’s outside partners.
items.title_zh: LastPass 再次通知用户发生数据泄露
items.summary: LastPass is notifying users of another data breach involving stolen personal data, which this time occurred through one of the company's outside partners.

items.title: Steam Machine launches today
items.title_zh: Steam Machine 今日发售
items.summary: The Steam Machine launches today, according to a Steam store announcement that links to a sale page, first-look coverage and a video.

items.title: Peking University and DeepSeek open-source DSpark, boosting LLM inference efficiency
items.title_zh: 北京大学与 DeepSeek 开源 DSpark，大幅提升大模型推理效率
items.summary: Peking University and DeepSeek jointly open-sourced DSpark, a speculative-decoding framework that the teams report boosts LLM inference speed by 60-85%, with up to a 661% throughput gain under strict latency constraints.

items.title: Anthropic cleared to release Claude Mythos 5 to over 100 US institutions
items.title_zh: Anthropic 获准向 100 多家美国机构发布 Claude Mythos 5
items.summary: After an export-control directive forced Anthropic to disable access to Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, the company reached a deal with the US government allowing Mythos 5 to be released to over 100 US institutions.

items.title: A man was gifted his dream car by Kevin Mitnick, who he helped put in prison
items.title_zh: 他协助将黑客 Kevin Mitnick 送进监狱，多年后收到对方赠予的梦想跑车
items.summary: Shawn Nunley stopped Kevin Mitnick with a cassette recorder, and decades later Mitnick left him enough money to buy his dream Porsche 911 GTS, according to the report.

items.title: Never Give Them Your Face
items.title_zh: 别把你的脸交给他们
items.summary: An opinion piece argues that age-verification checks are not really about verifying age but about building a permanent identity checkpoint over public life, and urges readers to refuse.

items.title: Claude Tag
items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Tag
items.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Tag, described as a new way for teams to work with Claude.

items.title: Show HN: TikZ Editor – WYSIWYG editor for figures in LaTeX
items.title_zh: Show HN：TikZ Editor，LaTeX 图形的所见即所得编辑器
items.summary: A developer built an open-source WYSIWYG editor for TikZ, the LaTeX package used to draw figures in papers, that displays source code and the rendered figure at the same time and keeps the two views in sync while either is edited. Available for web and desktop, it lets users drag and resize elements instead of hand-tuning coordinates.

items.title: Anthropic says Alibaba illicitly extracted Claude AI model capabilities
items.title_zh: Anthropic 称阿里巴巴非法提取 Claude 模型能力
items.summary: Anthropic says Alibaba illicitly extracted capabilities from its Claude AI model, according to a Reuters report.

items.title: Reid Hoffman says SpaceX 'not an AI company', xAI 'complete train wreck'
items.title_zh: Reid Hoffman：SpaceX 不是 AI 公司，xAI 是彻底的灾难
items.summary: Reid Hoffman, a LinkedIn cofounder and investor in both Anthropic and OpenAI, gave his most pointed public assessment yet of Elon Musk's AI ambitions, calling SpaceX 'not an AI company' and xAI a 'complete train wreck.'

items.title: Apple to skip high-end M6 Mac chips in favor of AI-focused M7 line
items.title_zh: Apple 将跳过高端 M6 Mac 芯片，转向主打 AI 的 M7 系列
items.summary: Apple reportedly plans to skip high-end M6 Mac chips and instead launch an AI-focused M7 line, according to a Bloomberg report.

items.title: OAuth for all
items.title_zh: OAuth 全面开放
items.summary: Cloudflare has made Self-Managed OAuth available to all developers, after carrying out a zero-downtime migration of its core OAuth engine.

items.title: Framework's 10G Ethernet module exposes USB-C's complexity
items.title_zh: Framework 的 10G 以太网模块暴露 USB-C 的复杂性
items.summary: Jeff Geerling tested WisdPi's 10G Ethernet Expansion Card for Framework computers, which fits any available Framework Expansion slot including the Framework Desktop, and noted that Expansion Cards connect over USB-C. WisdPi's adapters use newer Realtek chips that have sometimes shown performance quirks, most often under Linux.

items.title: The gap between open weights LLMs and closed source LLMs
items.title_zh: 开放权重 LLM 与闭源 LLM 之间的差距
items.summary: A Doubleword blog post uses Artificial Analysis benchmarks to estimate when an open-source LLM that matches frontier models might be released.

items.title: Robotaxis drive miles just to get cleaned and charged; this new startup wants to fix that
items.title_zh: Robotaxi 空驶数英里仅为清洁充电，新创业公司试图解决这一痛点
items.summary: Aseon Labs, a Y Combinator 2026 spring cohort company, raised $10 million from Crane Venture Partners and others to build dedicated pit stops for cleaning and charging robotaxis, addressing a key infrastructure gap in the autonomous ride-hailing ecosystem.

items.title: Why Wall Street thinks US memory maker Micron is the next Nvidia
items.title_zh: 华尔街为何认为美国存储厂商美光是下一个英伟达
items.summary: Hunting for AI-linked stocks that could match Nvidia's returns, Wall Street investors increasingly see memory-chip maker Micron as a leading candidate as AI demand tightens the memory market.

items.title: Canada plans 'nuclear renaissance' with up to 10 reactors built by 2040
items.title_zh: 加拿大公布“核能复兴”计划：2040 年前最多新建 10 座反应堆
items.summary: Canada's federal government is looking to build up to 10 new nuclear reactors over the next 15 years, with at least one of them outside Ontario, according to CBC.

items.title: Prosecutors used ChatGPT logs as evidence in the Palisades fire trial
items.title_zh: 检方在帕利塞兹大火审判中将 ChatGPT 记录用作证据
items.summary: In the arson case over the deadly Palisades wildfire, prosecutors introduced the defendant's ChatGPT logs as evidence alongside iPhone location data, security-camera footage, and witness testimony.

items.title: Peking University and DeepSeek open-source DSpark, boosting LLM inference efficiency

items.title: ByteDance-owned Pico’s Project Swan leak reveals Vision Pro-like design and external module
items.title_zh: 字节跳动旗下 Pico 的 Project Swan 曝光：设计类似 Vision Pro，配外置模块
items.summary: A leak reportedly shows Project Swan, a headset from ByteDance-owned Pico, with a Vision Pro-like design and an external module, according to TechNode.

items.title: YMTC NAND market share climbs to 13% as global competition intensifies
items.title_zh: YMTC 全球 NAND 市场份额升至 13%，竞争加剧
items.summary: Yangtze Memory Technologies Corporation has increased its global NAND flash market share from 8% in the same period of 2025 to 13%, according to TechNode, as global competition intensifies.

items.title: ECARX’s $266 million Flyme deal: a high-priced bet yet to be proven
items.title_zh: ECARX 2.66 亿美元收购 Flyme 软件业务：一笔尚未被验证的高价押注
items.summary: Nasdaq-listed ECARX announced a full acquisition of Flyme's software business from Xingji Meizu for RMB 1.8 billion, or about $266 million. The article characterizes it as a high-priced bet that has yet to be proven.

items.title: Forget the score, MWC Shanghai’s humanoid robot penalty shootout put embodied AI to the test
items.title_zh: 别管比分：MWC 上海人形机器人点球大战考验具身智能
items.summary: A fully autonomous humanoid robot penalty shootout drew some of the biggest crowds at MWC Shanghai 2026, standing out against smartphone and AI product launches, according to TechNode.

items.title: MediaTek Emerges as Major Challenger in Optical Interconnect Chip Market
items.title_zh: 联发科进军光互连芯片市场，挑战博通与 Marvell 双头垄断
items.summary: MediaTek enters the optical interconnect chip market with CPO (co-packaged optics) technology and Micro LED optical solutions, challenging the duopoly held by Broadcom and Marvell in high-speed data center interconnects.

items.title: 具身世界模型'我悟'通过合规备案
items.title_zh: 具身世界模型'我悟'通过合规备案
items.organization: 北京人形机器人创新中心
items.summary: 北京人形机器人创新中心慧思开物平台的双大脑模型天鹕（Pelican-VL）和我悟（WoW）同步完成北京市网信办生成式人工智能服务备案。北京人形将正式启动慧思开物全系列模型 Token 服务，计划分阶段面向产业客户、科研机构和开发者开放 API。

items.title: AgiBot rolls out its 15,000th mass-produced general-purpose embodied robot
items.title_zh: 智元第15000台通用具身机器人正式量产下线
items.summary: 6月28日，智元宣布通用具身机器人精灵G2第15000台正式量产下线，公司称这标志着中国人形机器人产业迈向大规模真实场景应用。

items.title: Nearly 20 Chinese motor makers race for humanoid robot first-mover advantage
items.title_zh: 近 20 家中国电机厂商争夺人形机器人先发优势
items.summary: Nearly 20 listed Chinese motor companies are competing in the humanoid-robot supply chain, with frameless torque motors and hollow-cup motors emerging as the dominant technical pathways.

items.title: UBTECH sells 5,000 companion robots in two weeks, eyes consumer market
items.title_zh: 优必选两周售出 5000 台陆伴机器人，瓜分消费市场突破
items.summary: UBTECH's U1 full-size humanoid companion robot logged more than 5,000 pre-orders in under three weeks, signaling growing consumer appetite for emotional AI robots in China.

items.title: BohemiaInteractive/CWR
items.title_zh: BohemiaInteractive/CWR：《Arma: Cold War Assault》重制版源码仓库
items.summary: The repository hosts the source code for Arma: Cold War Assault Remastered, published by Bohemia Interactive.

items.title: octanejs/octane
items.title_zh: octanejs/octane：编译版 React 编程模型，Inferno 的后继者
items.summary: Octane is described as React's programming model in compiled form and as the successor to Inferno.

items.title: bikini/exploitarium
items.title_zh: exploitarium：公开漏洞 PoC 与研究文章合集
items.summary: exploitarium is a Python archive of public exploit proof-of-concepts and vulnerability research writeups. Its author says none of the issues had been reported when posted, invites readers to report them, and asks users not to abuse the material.

items.title: davidondrej/skills
items.title_zh: davidondrej/skills：David Ondrej 的个人 Agent Skills
items.summary: A repository offering access to David Ondrej's personal agent skills, written in Shell.

items.title: aakarim/OpenLore
items.title_zh: OpenLore：极简的 Agent 原生知识仓库
items.summary: A minimal, extensible, agent-native knowledge repository designed to keep shared context current and inspectable.

items.title: CopilotKit/OpenTag
items.title_zh: CopilotKit/OpenTag：自托管 AI 值班分诊机器人
items.summary: OpenTag is a starter application from CopilotKit for a self-hosted AI on-call triage bot for Slack and Microsoft Teams, built with AG-UI and LangGraph in Python.

items.title: skymanbp/autoshade
items.title_zh: skymanbp/autoshade：AI 辅助 RAW 照片处理
items.summary: An AI-assisted RAW photo developer in which a GPT vision advisor proposes an EditRecipe and a deterministic Rust engine renders it, with Lightroom-compatible XMP sidecars, support for 24 RAW formats and a local GUI/web UI.

items.title: Robbyant/lingbot-map
items.title_zh: Robbyant/lingbot-map — 从流式数据重建场景的前馈式 3D 基础模型
items.summary: lingbot-map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data.

items.title: gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills
items.title_zh: gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills：74 个游戏开发 Agent Skills 合集
items.summary: A collection of 74 portable SKILL.md agent skills covering engines such as Godot, Unity, Unreal and Bevy, with a router that picks the right skill for the engine and task and support for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents.

items.title: Global Explanations for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Models via $K$-Order Markov Approximations
items.title_zh: 基于 K 阶马尔可夫近似的多变量时间序列预测模型全局解释
items.summary: The paper introduces KARMA, which explains time-series predictors by building a Markov surrogate that captures the temporal dependencies the predictor learned, then derives a five-level global explanation hierarchy from the estimated transition kernel. Tests on Beijing PM2.5 weather data and synthetic data with known causal edges show it recovers the learned causal structure and identifies temporal dependencies better than attribution methods such as TimeSHAP.

items.title: OctoSense: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Robot Perception
items.title_zh: OctoSense：面向多模态机器人感知的自监督学习
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers present OctoSense, an open-source sensor platform with stereo RGB and event cameras, LiDAR, thermal camera, IMU, and RTK-corrected GPS — all synchronized via hardware triggering. The paper introduces a self-supervised learning approach for fusing these multimodal streams for robust robot perception.

items.title: Residual GPU Cache State on Apple M4 Pro
items.title_zh: Apple M4 Pro 上的残留 GPU 缓存状态
items.summary: This paper characterizes the undocumented cache state left after a completed GPU command on Apple's 14-core M4 Pro, which exposes unified CPU-GPU memory, and validates the measurement pipeline used to probe that phase boundary.

items.title: Attributable by Construction: Claim-Anchored Provenance for Multi-Document Summarization
items.title_zh: 构造即归因：多文档摘要的声明锚定溯源
items.summary: CAMS decomposes source documents into atomic claims tied to verbatim quotes and token spans, clusters equivalent claims and flags conflicts, then rewrites a selected subset so that every summary sentence carries claim identifiers resolving to source spans. The authors report multi-source attribution accuracy rising from 38% to 64%, a 3.4x cut in human verification time per claim, and the release of about 320K claim-quote-span annotations.

items.title: Life After Benchmark Saturation: A Case Study of CORE-Bench
items.title_zh: 基准饱和之后：CORE-Bench 案例研究
items.summary: Using CORE-Bench Hard, a benchmark for computational reproducibility of scientific code, the authors argue that retiring a benchmark once accuracy saturates misses six other dimensions of agent performance, including construct validity, out-of-distribution generalization, efficiency, reliability, model-versus-scaffold importance and human-agent collaboration. They release CORE-Bench v1.1 and an out-of-distribution suite, and a small randomized experiment finds human-agent collaboration roughly twice as fast.

items.title: Optimizing CUDA like a Human: Micro-Profiling Tools as Expert Surrogates for LLM-Based GPU Kernel Optimization
items.title_zh: 像人类一样优化 CUDA：以微剖析工具作为 LLM GPU 内核优化的专家替代
items.summary: KernelPro is a closed-loop multi-agent system that generates, profiles and iteratively refines GPU kernels using LLM code generation and hardware profiler feedback, reporting geometric-mean speedups of 2.42x, 4.69x and 5.30x on KernelBench Levels 1–3 and an 11.6% energy reduction at matched speed.

items.title: Training Observable Control Policies to Expose Agent State Through Actions
items.title_zh: 训练可观测控制策略，通过动作暴露智能体状态
items.summary: The paper investigates using an agent's actions as a source of information about its state when communications are limited, training reinforcement-learning policies whose behavior makes estimation easier. In an aircraft tracking simulation, a policy with enhanced observability had minimal impact on nominal task performance.

items.title: PhysiFormer: Learning to Simulate Mechanics in World Space
items.title_zh: PhysiFormer：在世界空间中学习模拟力学
items.summary: PhysiFormer is a diffusion transformer that produces physically-plausible 3D object motion by representing objects as meshes in world coordinates rather than in view-dependent pixel space.
